alternate_mechanisms.name: discernment_or_bewilderment_before_spectacle
alternate_mechanisms.summary: The oath divides possibilities for thought; restraining intellect converts visible appearance into reflective judgment, whereas undisciplined attention can terminate in uncertainty and collapse of composure. Iram's spectacle is therefore a cognitive test as well as historical evidence.

alternate_mechanisms.name: measured_number_becomes_measured_monument
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Ten opens into dimension, division into proportion, creation into measured form, odd succession into an extended row, and enclosure plus pillar into bounded architecture. The same faculty that counts the oath can read Iram's geometry as created order rather than autonomous power.

alternate_mechanisms.name: outer_spectacle_and_inner_character
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Visible form can become public display, but deed-quality and inner disposition supply a different criterion of worth. The unmatched exterior becomes a warning sign precisely because appearance cannot settle the moral judgment requested by the passage.

alternate_mechanisms.name: community_built_around_human_and_divine_support
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Companionship and kin-group become a tent-pole community, then a settled polity held by human mainstays. The movement from social support to civic permanence remains nested under the authority of the Lord, whose action exposes the limits of every derived support.

alternate_mechanisms.name: oath_covenant_violated_sanctity_and_redress
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Oath, truce, covenant, violated sanctity, an outstanding claim for redress, and exemplary punishment form a legal-political underlay beneath the transition to Aad. It frames judgment as the answer to breached restraint without importing a specific treaty, feud, or battle into the surface narrative.

alternate_mechanisms.name: addressed_report_and_the_silent_past
alternate_mechanisms.summary: The present hearer is rhetorically alerted to an ancient people through a report that must be distinguished from fabricated narrative. Speechlessness contributes only an exploratory asymmetry: the past is made evidentially present but does not answer, while the hearer must judge the report.

alternate_mechanisms.name: upright_presence_to_grounded_effacement
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Height, upright presence, apparent duration, lying low, and ground contact form a reversal path from monumental visibility to possible effacement. It is licensed by the question about divine action but remains exploratory because the destruction is not narrated within 89:1-8.
